reason: I already have my routine with Toplux and Goli and I reorder when they run out. My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, not that I need a new brand, and a foil sachet every day feels like a lot of trash for something I could take from a bottle.
objection: A foil sachet a day for 30 days is more packaging waste, and I have no reason yet to switch from what I already trust.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor's blood test confirming low magnesium, plus a bottle or refill option instead of single-use sachets.
